design_note: Three atomic reference facts cover a 14-year-old son, daily sneaker wear, and 9 days of the side edge of his right big toenail digging into painful red swollen skin oozing scant clear fluid without naming onychocryptosis or paronychia and without contractions, with a 1-word span difference (18 vs 19 words). Under Rule A first choice and Rule D, replacing f3 at the right big toe with 15 minutes of mild pressure on the toe tip yesterday afternoon preserves the daily-sneakers context while shifting care cleanly from clinic care (level 2) to routine self-care (level 1).
